name: Nochnoe obshchestvo
source: 144-year-old vampire Axel has returned to  the Nocturne city after 2 years in China. Much has changed during his absence. The civil war between the vampires ended in victory for the New Order organization. Will there be peace  and prosperity in the free city of darkness, or is a new war inevitable?
